L5 gut-wall efflux records do not provide query-specific or dianionic-ARB data. No direct absolute oral bioavailability measurement exists for the query, and the L1 high-F contexts (phenylbutyrate, bumetanide, levodopa, suprofen) are structurally distant from this dianionic ARB, so they do not provide query-specific absorption evidence.
